summary: Real-case regression of melting temperature for engineered β-glucosidase variants.
what_it_measures: Standardized melting point (`melting_point_standardized`), a thermostability proxy, across β-glucosidase B variants.
assay_method: Experimental melting-temperature measurements on β-glucosidase variants in the Protein Engineering Tournament.
provenance: A 'real_case' β-glucosidase dataset from the Align Foundation tournament; one random split, stratified on the target.
when_to_use: Applied stability ranking within one enzyme family; the practical target when engineering more thermostable β-glucosidases.
caveats: Small, single-scaffold campaign; one random split, stratified on the target. Standardized target (MAE in standardized units).

citations.authors: The Protein Engineering Tournament (Align to Innovate)
citations.title: Results of the Protein Engineering Tournament: An Open Science Benchmark for Protein Modeling and Design
